# PR 539 / issue 519: bounded mathematical supersession assessment

Assessment UTC 2026-09-17; all source comparisons are pinned to PR head
`ca866da402947c9ee7e1dd5e935a2782fe0d1602`, merge base
`17746728be62eca55f929c71ae093fbb98d3eb37`, and trusted main/policy
`776d91f6a3939c10747c084fcf57c2db1a18cd3c`. Working tree:
`/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/.worktrees/issue-519-proof-tildem-consistent-pointmeas-prime`.
This is a read-only integration assessment, not a new PR review or proof.

## Mathematical boundary

Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex`,
`lem:qld-4-7` (1267-1274), constructs *both* global polynomial-pair
measurements with universal constants. `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`
(1463-1480) asserts both point comparisons and observable self-consistency
for the pulled-apart objects constructed from that pair. The proof at
1483-1605 includes the register-interchanged calculation, pulling argument,
and collision estimate. A universally *supplied* `GlobalPairWitness` is an
additional premise of an auxiliary, not the source theorem. The explicit
`0 <= epsilon <= 1` domain includes zero. The blueprint's documented
`deltaConstructPaulis` enlargement and encoding-restricted decoder correct
the source calculation; dropping the vacuous `j` in item 1 changes nothing.

## Completion, transitive checks, and limits

The original issue519 name denotes a *supplied-witness* target. It is proved
verbatim on pinned main in `Extraction/SuppliedPointConsistency.lean:226-269`;
the proof uses the encoding-supported reference, Alice-side mass comparison,
Schwartz-Zippel loss `md/q`, and `nlinarith` to absorb constants. It does not
call the still-open `nonencodingMarginalMass_le`. Independently, source-facing
`exists_pulled_apart_consistency` on main has no witness input and obtains
one constructed witness at *all* `0 <= epsilon <= 1`; the former
positive-error constructor premise was removed by PR535. These facts settle
the mathematical supersession of F1, not just a name match.

Checked here: git-blobs and normalized full theorem-block hashes, complete
source/paper/blueprint signature and proof-body comparisons, direct `sorry`
search in the relevant pinned-main leaves, and review/CI records. Main still
has direct `sorry` at `Extraction/Consistency.lean:649,697` (marginal
complement and general nonencoding theorem), and three separate open
directly-indexed extended-line assertions at `Combining/Apply.lean:80,115,157`.
The source-facing proof calls `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established`,
*not* any of those three open declarations; its source route is the proved
`exists_combinedPointsWitness`, `exists_combinedLinesWitness_ofPointsWitness`,
`subline_joint_overlap_near_one_at`, pair construction and scalar absorption.
The PR565 prover receipt for `6a504509` reports an actual target axiom query
of only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`; the independently recorded
PR567 reviewer at that head reports the same for the target and four principal
dependencies. PR535's historical axiom query independently reports the same
three axioms for `exists_globalPairWitness` and thirteen support declarations.
The pinned main has **not** been re-elaborated or axiom-queried in this task;
since 974d07ed its `Apply.lean` acquired only comments for an unrelated
open auxiliary and `ExtendedLines/Estimates.lean` changed import/proof setup.
Treat a fresh *pinned-main* transitive `#print axioms` as the remaining
verification receipt before an unconditional kernel-closure claim. The
historic queries and source dependency inspection support completion, but
neither a visible proof body nor CI alone certifies its current closure.
PR539 exact-head CI was green (all gating steps passed, 269s); latest
`local-review/summary` failed for the two F1/F2 findings. Eight conflicts
were identified by review 5235431556; none was resolved or recomputed here.
No Lean command, build, status publication, merge or other worktree operation
was run. Initial `git status --short --branch` printed only the branch line;
the final clean-state receipt is in the disposition and terminal response.

belongs in the packet. Do not merge the full PR, modify the
